claim: 在低持有成本与快速周转（高流动性）工作点：假设 C_cost = 0.05 * P_market，T_base = 1天，L_time = 0.01 * P_market/天，则 R_seller = 0.95 * P_market - 0.01 * P_market = 0.94 * P_market，ρ_seller = 0.94，代表理想化即时成交的效用上限。
evidence: 先验知识/题面给定，逻辑校验通过：R_seller = P_market - C_cost - L_time = P_market - 0.05*P_market - 0.01*P_market = 0.94*P_market，ρ_seller = R_seller/P_market = 0.94，计算无误且符合定义。
